higgs-decays.summary: Source-pinned explicit decay cards and supplied output transport; native execution awaits admitted stage integration.
Explicit Higgs decay cards, one-program branching sets and source-bound output transport.

use_when: A supplied model point and version-matched source descriptions define every native card field and output quantity.
do_not_use_when: A complete width is requested but only a four-fermion sector is available.
A source description, binary version pin or real native layout qualification is missing.

examples.phrase: Prepare a decay card for the supplied scalar population and parse its source-pinned outputs.

implementation_state: Card preparation and supplied-output parsing implemented; native execution and source-layout qualification remain pending.

integration_seams.scientific_dispatch: Import ravel.physics.higgs_decays in science.adapter and admit its request field through the scientific mode registry. The current module does not launch native work.
integration_seams.native_execution: Bind native_job command/card/expected outputs to an existing supervised stage with method decision and admission; no direct launch path.
integration_seams.binary_provider: Supply regular path/hash pins and version-matched manuals for every engine.
integration_seams.model_point_provider: Translate supplied scalar model bundles into schema-one explicit point fields; source completeness remains reviewed.
integration_seams.reference_provider: Supply cited branching rows and total_width/GeV rows at the requested mass.
integration_seams.scope_tools: Provide the FeynHiggs separate-program job interface; no upstream Python import.

handoff: Apply shared descriptors, signatures, manifest operation/groups, curation and workflow bundle declaration through the registration owner. Qualification jobs use supplied primary references; no past outputs or physics qualification are included.

change_registry_handoff.what: Explicit decay cards and source-bound output grammars
change_registry_handoff.why: Preserve physics inputs, one-program branching sets, width conservation and native admission boundaries.
change_registry_handoff.status: software transport implemented; native formats/execution await qualification
